summary: Join our Supervisory Stress Testing and Capital Planning to master essential techniques for effective risk management and regulatory compliance in finance.
lede: Stress testing examines how adverse scenarios could affect a financial institution’s risks, losses and capital position. For risk, finance, treasury, capital-management and supervisory professionals, this course develops practical skills in designing severe-but-plausible scenarios, translating them into credit, market and liquidity impacts, linking results to capital buffers, and planning management actions and clear reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who play a crucial role in risk management, finance, capital adequacy, and regulatory compliance across various financial sectors.
audience: Risk managers and enterprise risk teams
Credit risk and portfolio analytics teams
Internal audit and risk assurance professionals
Supervisory staff in central banks and regulators
ALM (asset-liability management) and balance sheet teams
modules: Supervisory Stress Testing and Capital Planning Foundations
Stress Testing Governance, Roles, and Controls
Reverse Stress Testing and Vulnerability Discovery
Integrating Stress Testing into Strategy and Budgeting
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial risk management and capital adequacy principles. Prior experience in risk or finance roles is recommended.
